title: Yanfly Auto Passive States for MZ

posts.author: K-apple
posts.body: I'm trying to make auto passive states for MZ. I know Yanfly has a plugin for MV but I can't find a similar one for MZ or at least one that functions similarly to Yanfly's. Does anyone have any recommendations? I tried looking for Visustella but I can't seem to find one or at least one that's as simple as the Yanfly MV version (nor do I think the Yanfly version is compatible with MZ.)

posts.author: AC11
posts.body:
That's already part of Visustella's Skills and States Core! It also has functions from Yanfly's Buff Core! If you download their sample project you can easily extract the plugin file from there or just download it straight from the Yanfly.moe website.
http://www.yanfly.moe/wiki/Skills_and_States_Core_VisuStella_MZ
If you want something really basic, then you can use this!
https://en.plugin-mz.fungamemake.com/archives/9440

posts.author: Piyan Glupak
posts.body: By the way, lots of Yanfly plugins work on MZ. Don't use his Core Engine, as that is incompatible with MZ. (Many Yanfly plugins don't actually need his Core Engine.) Can't remember whether the Auto Passive States worked with MZ or not when I tried it.
